snip.t: Vascular replacement for coronary bypass utilizes saphenous vein grafts with limited long-term patency due to atherosclerosis and intimal hyperplasia, while internal mammary artery grafts offer superior patency for specific applications.
Required for coronary bypass → grafts fashioned from saphenous veins (from patient's own leg) or left internal mammary artery
